articles.title: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO
articles.description: Amazon will own just under 15% of Anthropic after the IPO, with the option to go much higher. Google is a close second with holdings of nearly 14%.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: FBI says Artex AI open source hacking tool used to breach networks in ‘under three hours’
articles.description: The FBI says that the open source hacking tool was used in cyberattacks targeting a U.S. IT giant and the South Korean financial industry.
articles.author: Zack Whittaker

articles.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse is mixing up conversations and could be exposing private data, report says
articles.description: In some of these instances, employees said Muse surfaced messages about childcare requests they never made, career advice they never asked for, product orders they never placed, and bank account balances that didn't belong to them.
articles.author: Aisha Malik

articles.title: Nvidia says its open source AI strategy remains intact after Jensen Huang’s exit
articles.description: Nvidia's interim CEO reaffirmed its open source AI strategy and plans to acquire Hugging Face, despite Jensen Huang's sudden departure.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
articles.description: From Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy "super app" launch, here's a look at the AI projects that shut down or missed expectations.
articles.author: Lauren Forristal

articles.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explains why he asked 60K employees to quit
articles.description: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explained why he offered buyouts to 60,000 of his employees in October, essentially urging them to voluntarily quit, rather than reducing the workforce via another massive layoff. The short answer is AI, but not in the way you might expect.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: California state AG sues OpenAI over rogue agent incidents
articles.description: The California lawsuit represents one of the first attempts to hold an AI lab legally accountable for a rogue agent incident.
articles.author: Russell Brandom

articles.title: Where was Nvidia’s security team?
articles.description: Nvidia’s security chief quietly left in August, and now that CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down over his relationships, including one with an executive at a company suspected of funneling chips to China, a former intelligence officer says it’s the kind of leak that runs everyday conversations, which most corporate security teams are poorly equipped to catch.
articles.author: Connie Loizos

articles.title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
articles.description: The petition had attracted more than 115,000 signatures as of Saturday afternoon.
articles.author: Anthony Ha

articles.title: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac
articles.description: The iPhone maker appears to be building agents that can compete with the likes of Meta Muse, Instinct, Claude, and OpenAI Dots.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek
